Trump Considers Diesel Export Ban Amid Soaring Fuel Prices

Donald Trump has stated he would support a ban on diesel exports as fuel prices in the US reach record highs. Republican lawmakers have been pressuring the administration to curb exports. An industry trade group warned that such a ban could backfire and lead to even higher gasoline prices. The situation has been linked by one outlet to the war in Ukraine and Russia's strikes, which reportedly sent diesel prices soaring.
